description: A generic content embed block. Renders an optional heading and passes content through do_shortcode(). Use for WP plugin shortcodes (contact forms, calendars, etc.) that belong to WP rather than to the PromptingPress composition model. This is the only sanctioned way to introduce arbitrary content into a composition.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Optional section heading above the embedded content.

content.description: WP shortcode string or pre-rendered HTML. Passed through do_shortcode() and wp_kses_post(). Example: '[contact-form-7 id="123"]'.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

--embed-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--embed-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--embed-heading-size.description: Section heading font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop); set an explicit length to override.

--embed-heading-color.description: Section heading color. Defaults to the theme text color (inverted variant defaults to the inverted-background text color); set an explicit color to override.

--embed-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the embed section heading. Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--embed-body-measure.description: Maximum width of the EMBEDDED CONTENT column. Deliberately a body measure, not a heading one: it keeps its own 40rem default rather than routing --measure-heading, so retuning band heading measure never re-flows embedded content.

--embed-body-color.description: Embedded content text color. Defaults to the inherited body text color on a default or muted band and to the inverted-background text color on an inverted band; set an explicit color to override.
